newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: PANEL OKAYS UBS TELECOM ADVISOR CONTRACT.
newsitem.headline: PANEL OKAYS UBS TELECOM ADVISOR CONTRACT.

text.p: Officials said on Tuesday that the privatisation commission had approved a deal for Union Bank of Switzerland to act as the government's adviser in the sale of a stake in Lithuanian Telecom.

"The privatisation commission has approved the draft agreement so it has to be signed today," Alfredas Ramanauskas, deputy director of the privatisation department at the European Affairs Ministry, told Reuters.
Ramanauskas said there would be a press conference in the communications ministry at 1630 following the signing of the agreement, which is a closed event.
As the government's lead advisor in the sale of Lithuanian Telecom, as well as the radio and television centre, Union Bank of Switzerland will have to draw up a privatisation programme by November.
The programme will set out the government's strategy in selling Telecom, specifically, how much will be sold and how the deal will take place. It will also include the obligations of the buyer.
Lithuanian Telecom is one of over a dozen state-owned companies the government plans to sell in open international tenders this year and next.
Union Bank of Switzerland was chosen from a field of seven candidates that made the government's short list of applicants for the advisory spot.
But the signing of the agreement was delayed due to what officials said was disagreements over wording in the contract.
Ramanauskas said the terms of the contract were kept confidential by mutual agreement.
